Name: Desaturated Ridgeside Village
Author: itstern
Description:
This mod uniformly desaturates all [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] assets for a softer look and better compatibility with popular recolors. Every asset, from portraits to items to maps and more, is desaturated. Other mods that edit RSV's assets will take priority over this one, so you can mix and match. Think of this mod as a catch-all for anything that isn't affected by another recolor mod.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/pLgTcMBt/compatibility.png[/img]﻿

Should be compatible with all mods, including major expansions.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. You can turn desaturation on or off (default on) for individual characters' sprites/portraits, as well as for broad categories (like Furniture, Crops/forage, etc.).

This was specifically made to match [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/herbivoor?gameId=1303]Herbivoor[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20749]Universal Recolors[/url] (significant preset). I recommend using both!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fLjYhfz5/troubleshooting.png[/img]

This mod doesn't currently cover the spirit realm or the tourists in the hotel--I just couldn't get them to work. Open to suggestions!

Please let me know if you run into anything else!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0Q5sgrsb/my-mods.png[/img]﻿
